tasks.short: Verify freight documentation against applicable requirements

steps.what: Identify applicable customs, insurance and regulatory requirements for the documentation
Compare required documentation fields and dates against the selected checklist
Verify substantive adherence, resolve discrepancies and record the documentation review outcome

tasks.design: Configure fixed completeness and field comparisons in {OPS_SYSTEM} against the forwarder's selected checklist. Keep applicability, insurance meaning and substantive adherence with the forwarder, who records the outcome for exact document versions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated field checks mix with interpretation of requirements and document meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field validation can flag simple mismatches without declaring a shipment compliant.
tasks.still_hard: Determine which requirements apply and whether the documents genuinely meet them.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a superficially complete but substantively inadequate document.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive field comparison; no new authority to clear goods or interpret requirements.

reach.learn: Distinguish a field mismatch from a substantive compliance issue.

evidence.claim: Fixed completeness and consistency checks can assist a human documentation review; the proposal does not establish legal or insurance compliance automatically.

assumptions: Boundary is documentation review, excluding document creation, customs declaration, goods inspection and broker arrangements.

Existing shipment and document owners produce the record and documents before s1. The forwarder selects current requirements and captures document identifier/version, shipment reference, required fields, source values, dates, units and checklist version during retained s1 time; no free structured compliance flag is assumed.
Compliance staff maintain the authoritative requirements in their existing workflow. Additional machine-check configuration review costs 3 other-role hours per 100 focal baseline hours.
s2 produces discrepancies, not a compliance verdict. Unreadable documents, free text and uncertain applicability remain manual in s1 and s3, with no saving claimed for extraction.
Test native configuration first. Savings require presently manual field comparisons, not existing validation runtime. Additional focal upkeep is 8 hours per 100 baseline hours.
research_questions: Which manual checks can be represented as exact field comparisons without interpreting insurance or customs meaning?

already_counted.description: Applicability selection, input capture and substantive review remain.

incremental.description: Review check failures and maintain local validation settings.
Additional review of configured requirement checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact shipment, document identifiers and versions, requirement checklist version, discrepancies and recorded review outcome; any change voids the review approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+40=75; gross=25, focal upkeep=8, central net=17. Conservative 3-9 assumes many documents still need manual comparison or substantive clarification.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain knowledge of freight legislation and operating conditions

steps.what: Select relevant legislation, political situations and shipping topics to monitor
Collect new source notices relevant to the selected shipping topics
Read source notices and interpret implications for current freight shipping work

tasks.design: Configure official subscriptions and saved source links in {EMAIL} and {DOCS} to collect original notices. The forwarder still reads the originals, interprets relevance and asks specialists about uncertainty; no generated legal brief replaces that work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly visiting source sites can consume time before the actual reading begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing subscription and notification functions can deliver the original notice.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a proposal, an effective change and an operational disruption, and understand its relevance.
tasks.human_edge: Connect verified developments to actual cargo and trade lanes.
tasks.altitude: Less source collection; the forwarder retains all interpretation work.

reach.learn: Check publication status and consult authoritative originals.

evidence.claim: Native subscriptions can collect source notices, while interpretation remains human; the time-saving scenario is unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is personal knowledge maintenance, excluding drafting company rules or deciding shipment-specific compliance.

The forwarder selects sources and captures source identifier, subscription address, topic, jurisdiction, trade lane and review frequency in s1. Native subscriptions carry original notice identifier, publisher, publication time, title and source location; publishers produce those notices in their existing publication work, with no new supplier duty.

s2 only collects the original notices from supported subscriptions and removes exact identifier duplicates. A missing feed or unstructured source requires manual site review in retained work and earns no collection saving.
The forwarder checks date, source status and relevance in s3. Specialist interpretation is sought through the existing route, not assumed to be a free machine-produced flag.
Test native subscription settings first. Existing automated delivery earns no new saving; additional subscription upkeep and missed-notice checks cost 8 focal hours per 100 baseline hours.
unknowns: Which authoritative sources offer usable subscriptions
research_questions: Do configured subscriptions deliver all relevant originals compared with the current manual source review?

already_counted.description: Topic selection, reading and interpretation remain human.

incremental.description: Check subscription coverage and investigate missing or duplicate notices.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+0+50=70; gross=30, upkeep=8, central net=22. Conservative 4-12 allows poor feed coverage and manual site checking; reading and interpretation remain fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend and arrange appropriate merchandise packing

steps.what: Assess packing needs from climate, terrain, weight, goods characteristics and costs
Recommend appropriate merchandise packing methods and arrange agreed packing with the provider

tasks.design: Use the shipment record in {OPS_SYSTEM} and existing packing specifications in {DOCS} to support the forwarder's assessment. Keep selection and arrangement of suitable packing with the forwarder and provider.
tasks.previous_blocker: Packing suitability depends on the actual goods and route conditions, not just a generic rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing specifications support the decision without removing assessment or agreement time.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve incomplete cargo information and judge protection against cost and handling constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when specialist packing advice is necessary before making a commitment.
tasks.altitude: Packing advice and arrangement responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clarify cargo sensitivity, handling conditions and provider limitations.

evidence.claim: Cargo packing recommendations require contextual assessment of goods and transport conditions; a shipment record alone does not establish suitability.

assumptions: Boundary is packing assessment and arrangement, excluding physical packing and original measurements, which remain separately owned and unchanged.

The shipper supplies cargo dimensions, weight, fragility and known restrictions through the existing shipment process before s1. The forwarder checks them and clarifies route exposure and costs in s1; no structured suitability flag is assumed.

Customer preferences and provider constraints are discussed during s2 before the exact request is approved and sent. Existing provider and customer participation remains unchanged, with no new capture work transferred.
Native record and document access suffice. This unchanged process adds no tool or upkeep, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Cargo information quality and specialist packing arrangements
research_questions: Which cargo characteristics most often require provider clarification before a packing recommendation?

already_counted.description: Assessment, agreement and approval of the provider request remain fully counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact cargo reference, packing method, specifications, provider, agreed costs and request text approved before sending in s2; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No assessment or provider arrangement time is automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm shipment scope and capture details needed for customs broker arrangements
Assemble the broker request and referenced shipment documents
Review and send the request, then make arrangements with customs brokers

tasks.design: Configure a broker-request template in {OPS_SYSTEM} using checked shipment fields and exact document references. The forwarder verifies the pack, approves the exact version and sends it through {EMAIL}, then handles broker questions and agreement personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copying shipment details and attaching documents can repeat information already checked for the request.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can assemble known fields and references without deciding customs treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Clarify broker responsibilities, missing information and unusual shipment requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Agree workable arrangements and recognise questions requiring a declarant's judgement.
tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly; the forwarder retains the broker relationship and request approval.

reach.learn: Identify required document versions and distinguish instructions from customs decisions.

evidence.claim: Qargo and TransFollow support creation and signing of eCMRs inside a transport system; this demonstrates native transport-document handling, not this broker-pack design or its saving.
Broker-pack assembly from checked fields is an unmeasured configuration proposal and does not automate customs judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is broker-request preparation and arrangement, excluding document compliance review, customs declaration and broker processing. Those tasks retain separate ownership and no saving is duplicated.

The forwarder captures shipment reference, parties, requested broker service, deadline, contact, document identifiers and versions, and special instructions in s1. Existing shipment owners create the source record before s1; missing or unstructured details require manual clarification in retained time.
s2 uses only checked fields and document references produced in s1. It cannot infer tariff classification, authority or a clearance status. Missing fields stop pack generation for manual handling.
Broker replies occur after the request is sent in s3 and are handled in its retained conversation time. Existing broker work is unchanged, with no new supplier capture duty.
Test native templates first. Additional focal upkeep is 7 hours per 100 baseline hours; already automated packs earn no new saving.
research_questions: Can a native template assemble a complete broker pack without inventing or misidentifying document versions?

already_counted.description: Input capture, pack verification, approval and broker coordination remain.

incremental.description: Maintain request fields and investigate assembly exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact pack version, shipment, broker recipient, requested service, deadline, instructions and attached document versions reviewed before sending in s3; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+40=75; gross=25, focal upkeep=7, central net=18. Conservative 3-10 allows broker-specific formats and manual document clarification; coordination time receives no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The forwarder retains compliance interpretation, packing decisions and broker relationships while fixed checks, notice collection and pack assembly may become quicker.
reach: Help freight agents distinguish field completeness from substantive compliance.
Prepare clear requests for brokerage clerks.
role.ambitious_version: Use released clerical time to resolve unusual freight requirements without treating automatic field checks as customs clearance.
